# Personal Finance Coach Skill for Muse

A personal-finance coach built on academic research, not platitudes: modern portfolio theory and factor investing, tax optimization (asset location, tax-loss harvesting, Roth conversion ladder), withdrawal mathematics (Trinity Study, Guyton-Klinger, Monte Carlo simulations), and FIRE calculations (FI number, Coast/Barista FIRE, CAPE-adjusted safe withdrawal rates). Documented anti-patterns throughout, with explicit disclaimers: education, NOT personalized financial advice and no stock picks. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: US-centric content (Roth, 401k) — a Quebec reader will need to translate the account types — and educational only, no substitute for an advisor. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
